question: Which is the longest railway line in the world?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Trans-Siberian Railway**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The longest railway line in the world is **Trans-Siberian Railway**.
 
• The **Trans–Siberian Railway** connects **Moscow with the Russian** far east. Its running distance is **9,259 kilometres or 5,753 miles**. The journey takes (167 hours) 6 days to complete.
 
• The Trans-Siberian railway line has connected **Moscow to Vladivostok since 1916**, and it is still being expanded. There are also branch lines into **Mongolia, China, and North Korea**.
 
• **Tsar Alexander III** **and his son** personally appointed ministers to build this railway line from **1891 to 1916**.
 
• **Trans- Siberian Railway** played an important role in **World War II** in supplying the powers fighting in Europe. It also transported Soviet troops west from the Far East to take part in the Soviet counteroffensive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Railway line
 Description
 
 

 The Union-Pacific railway
 **Union Pacific Railroad is a U.S. Class I railroad** owned by Union Pacific Corporation operating 3**1,800 route miles of track and covering 23 states** in the western two-thirds of the United States.
 
 

 The Australian Trans-Continental Railway
 
 
**This is the longest route of Australia, **connecting Sydney in the east to Perth in the west.

 
Major junctions on this route are **Broken Hill, Kalgoorlie, and Coolgardie**.

 
The route includes the **longest length of straight track in the world- 478.193 kilometers** (297.135 miles).

 
 
 

 Trans-Canadian Railway
 
 
**The longest trans-continental railway of North America is Trans-Canadian Railway**.

 
It has **7,000 kilometers** long rail line. It runs between Halifax city of Nova Scotia and Prince Rupert of British Columbia. this line is the economic artery of Canada.
